# namecheap-cli command reference

Global options go BEFORE the resource: `namecheap-cli -o json domain list`.
Usage guide, safety rules, and workflows: CLI.md.

## `namecheap-cli`

```
Usage: namecheap-cli [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Namecheap CLI - Manage domains and DNS records.

Options:
  --config PATH                   Config file path
  --profile TEXT                  Config profile to use
  --sandbox                       Use sandbox API
  -o, --output [table|json|yaml|csv]
                                  Output format
  --no-color                      Disable colored output
  -q, --quiet                     Minimal output
  -v, --verbose                   Verbose output
  --debug                         Show full traceback on errors
  --version                       Show the version and exit.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  account     Account management commands.
  completion  Generate shell completion script.
  config      Configuration management commands.
  dns         DNS record management commands.
  domain      Domain management commands.
  privacy     Domain privacy (WhoisGuard) management.
  skill       Claude Code skill management.
```

## `namecheap-cli account pricing`

```
Usage: namecheap-cli account pricing [OPTIONS] [TLD]

  Get domain pricing. Optionally filter by TLD.

  Examples:     namecheap-cli account pricing com     namecheap-cli account
  pricing --action RENEW     namecheap-cli account pricing io --action REGISTER

Options:
  -a, --action [register|renew|transfer|reactivate]
                                  Pricing action
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

## `namecheap-cli dns`

```
Usage: namecheap-cli dns [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  DNS record management commands.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  add                   Add a DNS record.
  delete                Delete DNS records.
  email-forwarding      Show email forwarding rules for a domain.
  export                Export DNS records.
  list                  List DNS records for a domain.
  nameservers           Show current nameserver configuration for a domain.
  reset-nameservers     Reset domain to use Namecheap's default nameservers.
  set-email-forwarding  Set email forwarding rules.
  set-nameservers       Set custom nameservers for a domain.
```

## `namecheap-cli dns add`

```
Usage: namecheap-cli dns add [OPTIONS] DOMAIN
                             {a|aaaa|cname|mx|txt|ns|url|url301|frame} NAME
                             VALUE

  Add a DNS record.

Options:
  --ttl INTEGER       TTL in seconds (60-86400, default: 1799 = Automatic)
  --priority INTEGER  Priority (required for MX records)
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

## `namecheap-cli dns delete`

```
Usage: namecheap-cli dns delete [OPTIONS] DOMAIN

  Delete DNS records.

Options:
  -t, --type TEXT   Record type to delete
  -n, --name TEXT   Record name to delete
  -v, --value TEXT  Record value to delete
  --all             Delete all records (dangerous!)
  -y, --yes         Skip confirmation
  --help            Show this message and exit.
```


## `namecheap-cli dns reset-nameservers`

```
Usage: namecheap-cli dns reset-nameservers [OPTIONS] DOMAIN

  Reset domain to use Namecheap's default nameservers.

  This switches the domain back to Namecheap BasicDNS from custom nameservers.

Options:
  -y, --yes  Skip confirmation
  --help     Show this message and exit.
```

## `namecheap-cli dns set-email-forwarding`

```
Usage: namecheap-cli dns set-email-forwarding [OPTIONS] DOMAIN RULES...

  Set email forwarding rules. Replaces all existing rules.

  Rules are in mailbox:forward_to format.

  Example:     namecheap-cli dns set-email-forwarding example.com
  info:me@gmail.com support:help@gmail.com

Options:
  -y, --yes  Skip confirmation
  --help     Show this message and exit.
```

## `namecheap-cli dns set-nameservers`

```
Usage: namecheap-cli dns set-nameservers [OPTIONS] DOMAIN NAMESERVERS...

  Set custom nameservers for a domain.

  This switches the domain from Namecheap's default DNS to custom nameservers.

  Example:     namecheap-cli dns set-nameservers example.com ns1.route53.com
  ns2.route53.com

Options:
  -y, --yes  Skip confirmation
  --help     Show this message and exit.
```

## `namecheap-cli privacy`

```
Usage: namecheap-cli privacy [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Domain privacy (WhoisGuard) management.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  change-email  Rotate the privacy forwarding email address.
  disable       Disable domain privacy.
  enable        Enable domain privacy.
  list          List WhoisGuard subscriptions.
  renew         Renew domain privacy subscription.
```

## `namecheap-cli privacy change-email`

```
Usage: namecheap-cli privacy change-email [OPTIONS] DOMAIN

  Rotate the privacy forwarding email address.

  Namecheap generates a new masked email automatically.

  Example:     namecheap-cli privacy change-email example.com

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

## `namecheap-cli privacy disable`

```
Usage: namecheap-cli privacy disable [OPTIONS] DOMAIN

  Disable domain privacy.

  Example:     namecheap-cli privacy disable example.com

Options:
  -y, --yes  Skip confirmation
  --help     Show this message and exit.
```

## `namecheap-cli privacy enable`

```
Usage: namecheap-cli privacy enable [OPTIONS] DOMAIN EMAIL

  Enable domain privacy. Requires forwarding email.

  --help  Show this message and exit.
```
